ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence on PEPs under Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP, comprising foreign, domestic and international-organization PEP categories; mandatory screening of UBOs, representatives and counterparties against the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, Vietnamese domestic sanctions lists issued by the State Bank of Vietnam and competent ministries, and applicable EU/UK sanctions for correspondent banking; ongoing real-time and periodic re-screening required at onboarding and on new sanctions designations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, administered by the Business Registration Management Agency under the Ministry of Planning and Investment, with provincial-level Departments of Planning and Investment as receiving authorities
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The enterprise name must be written in the Vietnamese language script using Vietnamese letters, may contain Arabic numerals and symbols, and must be able to be pronounced in Vietnamese; foreign-invested enterprises may use an additional translated name but the Vietnamese name is the authoritative statutory name; English-only names or names using non-Vietnamese scripts are not acceptable for the official business name; foreign names and proper names must be transliterated/transcribed into Vietnamese orthography where required
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered enterprise or to another enterprise's trade name in the same industry

Names using wording of state agencies, political organizations, people's armed forces, state-owned enterprises, national entities, or names of national heroes and revolutionary leaders without authorization
Words contrary to Vietnamese national history, culture, ethics, customs and traditions
Improper use of the words 'Viet Nam', 'Tổ quốc', 'Chính phủ', 'Bộ', 'Ủy ban', or similar national symbols
'Ngân hàng' (bank) and credit-institution words requiring a State Bank of Viet Nam license
'Chứng khoán' (securities), 'Tài chính' (finance), or 'Quỹ' (fund) words triggering securities and capital-market licensing requirements
'Tin tức' (news), 'Báo' (press), or 'Thông tấn' (news agency) words requiring press/permission under the Press Law and Ministry of Information and Communications regulation
Names or abbreviations implying syndicated lending or deposit-taking activities without a credit institution license
Offensive, vulgar, or misleading names inciting deception or confusion as to the legal form or ownership of the enterprise
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the business name is rejected, the applicant receives a written refusal stating the legal ground; the applicant may immediately correct and resubmit the registration dossier through the National Business Registration Portal or at the provincial Department of Planning and Investment. If the applicant disputes the refusal, the formal administrative appeal is submitted within 30 days to the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment, and in the alternative to the Minister of Planning and Investment through the Business Registration Management Agency, under the Law on Handling of Administrative Violations and the Law on Administrative Procedures; judicial review via the administrative court is available after exhaustion or concurrently in appropriate statutory circumstances.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory head office; the LLC must have a physical registered business address in Viet Nam that is verified, accessible and used for service of process and corporate records; virtual-only or mail-forwarding addresses are not accepted for the Business Registration Certificate; a genuine serviced office/coworking space lease with designated address may be accepted if the address is identifiable, a lease agreement is in force, and the space is actually available for inspection.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate, estimated 10% probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered head office within the first 24 months for a non-licensed, low-risk B2B financial newswire API LLC; the probability increases materially if the registered office discloses a virtual address, if the enterprise fails to maintain a physical lease/signage, or if UBO documentation inconsistencies or AML red flags are detected.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (effective 1 January 2021), Articles 22 (registration), 24-26 (charter and registered details), 27-30 (registration dossier, procedure and refusal), 43 (corporate seal), 51 (legal representative), 57 (Members' Council), 74-77 (charter capital contribution); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 22, 38-39 (Investment Registration Certificate for foreign investors); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP implementing the Law on Investment; Decree No. 122/2021/ND-CP on registration fees.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) under the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province / centrally run city, acting through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn); for foreign-invested projects, the Investment Registration Division of the DPI or the Management Board of the industrial/export-processing zone where the enterprise is located.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp), Form I-1 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, filed online via the National Business Registration Portal concurrently with the annexed Company Charter, List of Members, and Investment Registration Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No general statutory minimum charter capital applies to a limited liability company under the Enterprise Law. Under Article 26 of the Law on Investment, the charter capital committed by the foreign investor must be commensurate with the scale and implementation schedule of the registered ISIC 6391 project, which is assessed by the DPI. The entire subscribed charter capital must be fully contributed within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Article 75 of the Enterprise Law 2020). Vietnamese law does not mandate a separate escrow account; however, the contributed funds must be remitted into and maintained in a dedicated capital contribution account in the company's name at a commercial bank licensed in Viet Nam, evidenced by SWIFT/MT103 or local transfer records.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE MEMBERS' COUNCIL / OWNER OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (INCORPORATION AND GOVERNANCE). ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT, dated [●], in [Hanoi / Ho Chi Minh City], Viet Nam. WHEREAS, the Company is a limited liability company to be incorporated under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, having obtained Investment Registration Certificate No. [●/IRC]; WHEREAS, all members owning 100% of the charter capital approve this Resolution in accordance with Article 57 of the Enterprise Law and the draft Charter; NOW, IT IS RESOLVED: (1) CHARTER CAPITAL AND SUBSCRIPTION: The charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [●] (approximately USD [●]), subscribed by the members as set forth in the annexed Capital Subscription Schedule. Each member irrevocably undertakes to pay its subscribed capital in full within 90 days of the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate in accordance with Article 75 of the Enterprise Law; (2) CHARTER: The Company Charter annexed to this Resolution, containing all mandatory particulars required by Article 25 of the Enterprise Law, is adopted in its final form; (3) REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office of the Company is fixed at [Floor, Building, Street, Ward, District, City], Viet Nam, as it will appear on the Enterprise Registration Certificate; (4) OFFICERS: [Name A] is appointed Chairman of the Members' Council / Owner; [Name B] is appointed General Director and shall serve as the sole Legal Representative of the Company for all corporate, regulatory, banking, and licensing matters until replaced by a subsequent resolution; (5) BANKING: The General Director is authorized to open a charter capital contribution account at [Bank, Branch], obtain the corporate seal, and execute all instruments for the receipt and disbursement of subscribed capital; (6) AUTHORIZATIONS: The General Director is authorized to file the enterprise registration application, publish registration content on the National Business Registration Portal, register tax identification matters, execute the office lease, and perform all acts necessary to achieve the Company's corporate purpose of financial market news aggregation and syndication feed services (ISIC 6391); (7) GENERAL: This Resolution is effective immediately and shall bind all members and the Company until amended by a resolution of the Members' Council / Owner. UNANIMOUSLY RESOLVED on [●].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for Foreign-Invested Project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Division (Phòng Đăng ký đầu tư) of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI); for projects located in industrial/export-processing zones, the Management Board of the industrial/export-processing zone; electronic filing via the National Investment Portal (dautunuoangoai.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the investment dossier in Vietnamese (or bilingual with a notarized Vietnamese translation), file one original set electronically and one hard copy at the Investment Registration Division. The authority screens the application on the National Investment Portal within 3 working days, then evaluates it within 10 working days; the IRC is issued under Article 38 of the Law on Investment and Decree 31/2021/ND-CP. Foreign ownership is unrestricted for ISIC 6391, so no sectoral conditions or conditional investment list review is triggered, though the project charter capital must be adequate for the stated newswire operation. Amend the IRC later for any increase in scope or capital before ERC issuance.
required_dossiers: Application form for investment project implementation (Form I-1, Decree 31/2021/ND-CP)
Investment project proposal (Form I-2) describing the financial newswire aggregation API platform, data sourcing and licensing model
Investor's certificate of incorporation, statute, and passport copies of authorized signatories (legalized/consularized as applicable)
Financial capacity statement (Form I-3) supported by bank confirmation or audited financial statements of the last two fiscal years
Project implementation plan including capital contribution schedule, staffing, premises, and API data licensing contracts
Office lease intention letter or proof of lawful right to use the proposed premises
Terms-of-service and data consent framework demonstrating lawful news aggregation rather than press licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a dossier is queried, the applicant receives a written request for supplementation under Article 38 of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP; remedy the deficiency within 10 working days and resubmit on the National Investment Portal. If the IRC is refused, the applicant may (i) seek written reasons, (ii) submit an amended project proposal addressing the stated grounds, or (iii) file an administrative complaint with the DPI Director or the Provincial People's Committee under Articles 68-69 of the Law on Investment, followed by recourse to administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Application for Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) of the DPI; online submission exclusively through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the IRC is issued, submit the enterprise registration dossier electronically within 30 days. The Business Registration Office reviews the dossier under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP and issues the ERC within 3 working days if the dossier is complete and lawful. The ERC name, registered office, charter capital, legal representative, and ISIC code 6391 (News agency activities) must match the IRC precisely. The Certificate of Enterprise Registration constitutes conclusive proof of corporate existence and legal personality under Article 29 of the Enterprise Law.
required_dossiers: Application for enterprise registration (Form I-1, Decree 01/2021/ND-CP)
Company Charter signed by all members or their authorized representatives (Form I-3 reference)
List of members (Form I-6) with capital contribution ratios
Notarized copies of passports/ID cards of all members and the legal representative
Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) issued in Step 1
Written appointment/consent of the legal representative (Form I-8)
First Board Resolutions and incorporation minutes approving the charter and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For a deficiency, the Business Registration Office issues a written Notice of Non-Compliance within 3 working days; correct and resubmit the dossier online within 15 working days without losing priority. If the ERC is refused, request the written refusal grounds, correct the specific item, and refile; alternatively, appeal under Article 30 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP and the administrative procedure law, then seek judicial review at the competent administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Registration Content on the National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) under the Agency for Business Registration of the Ministry of Planning and Investment; the DPI exercises oversight.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately upon ERC issuance, file the legally mandated publication content (company name in Vietnamese and English, registered office, ERC number, legal representative, charter capital, ISIC 6391 line of business) on the National Business Registration Portal and pay the publication fee. The content must be posted three consecutive times on the portal within 30 days of ERC issuance, as required by Article 30 of the Enterprise Law and Decree 01/2021/ND-CP. Retain the portal-generated publication receipt for the dossier of the first board meeting and for bank and contract counterparty verification.
required_dossiers: Pre-filled content notice generated from the National Business Registration Portal
ERC number and personal identification/verification codes of the legal representative
Proof of publication fee payment (VND 300,000) through the national payment gateway
Copy of the ERC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the online publication fails due to fee rejection or system error, re-pay the fee at the State Treasury collection gateway and request manual publication support from the portal helpdesk, which must resolve within 3 working days. Any substantive error in published content is cured by filing an amended notice within 10 working days; failure to file timely is subject to an administrative sanction, which can be remedied by immediate voluntary filing and proof of correction submitted to the DPI.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal Creation/Declaration, Bank Account Opening, and Charter Capital Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks licensed by the State Bank of Vietnam (account opening and capital contribution); the National Business Registration Portal for seal declaration; no prior government approval is required for seal use under Article 43 of the Enterprise Law.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is issued, prepare the corporate seal through a licensed seal engraving house; the seal controller, the legal representative, must declare the seal specimen on the National Business Registration Portal within the required time (seal notification is an online declaration, not a pre-approval). Open the capital contribution account at a licensed commercial bank using the ERC, Charter, IRC, the First Resolution, and identities of authorized signatories; the bank must complete KYC verification. The foreign members then remit their subscribed charter capital into this account; full contribution must occur within 90 days of ERC issuance. Contribution must be documented by SWIFT/MT103 (for inbound foreign remittances) or local transfer slips, with the purpose stated as 'contribution to charter capital'. After full contribution, file the charter capital contribution statement and amended registration details if any member's contributed amount deviates from the registered allocation.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
Company Charter adopted by the First Resolution
Investment Registration Certificate (IRC)
First Board Resolution appointing authorized signatories and bank mandate
Passport/ID copies of the legal representative and controllers
Corporate seal specimen and seal declaration receipt from the National Business Registration Portal
Bank account opening forms and comprehensive KYC pack
SWIFT/MT103 or domestic transfer evidence of charter capital remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines opening due to KYC discrepancies, correct the identification documents and resubmit; if the 90-day capital contribution deadline is not achieved, the members must either contribute the shortfall or the Members' Council must resolve to reduce charter capital and file a corresponding amendment with the Business Registration Office within 30 days as required by Article 75.3 of the Enterprise Law, or commence voluntary dissolution; administrative sanctions for late registration of changes are cured by filing the amendment promptly and paying the administrative fine.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Physical Site, Fire Safety, and Occupational Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Prevention, Fighting and Rescue Police (PC07) of the Provincial Police for fire safety; Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environmental registration; district-level labor inspectorate under the Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Welfare (DOLISA) for occupational safety.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing operations at the newswire service office (including server rooms and lettable floors), the lessee must verify that the building owner has obtained the fire safety design appraisal and acceptance certificate under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP (as amended by Decree No. 83/2024/ND-CP); if the enterprise is the occupier of a new/renovated premise, file a fire safety design appraisal dossier with PC07 before fit-out and an acceptance application after completion. Submit the simplified Environmental Registration (Đăng ký môi trường) to the DONRE under Article 49 of Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP if the premises are not already covered by the building's environmental permit; for pure office/IT activities, a full Environmental Impact Assessment is not required. Register the workplace under the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH14 (hazard declaration DOLISA Form), appoint a safety supervisor, and keep training and fire drill records on site. The office lease agreement must be notarized if the lease term exceeds 12 months for proper registration with the authorities.
required_dossiers: Fire safety design appraisal dossier (Form No. 01/136/ND-CP) and fire safety acceptance minutes for the leased premises
Owner's fire safety certificate or building acceptance documentation
Simplified environmental registration form (Bản đăng ký môi trường) under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP and Circular 02/2022/TT-BTNMT
Office floor plan and structural load clearance from the licensed lessor
Occupational safety and health hazard declaration (khai báo an toàn vệ sinh lao động) filed with DOLISA
Workplace safety internal rules and training records
Waste collection contract with a licensed solid-waste operator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If PC07 issues a notice of non-compliance prior to acceptance, remediate the cited deficiencies (e.g., insufficient fire extinguishers, blocked escape routes) within 10 working days and re-request inspection; no fine is imposed if the acceptance is completed before operations commence. If DONRE rejects the environmental registration, correct the discharge and waste data and refile within 15 working days; obtain a temporary written consent for continuing administrative operations. Any occupational safety query by the labor inspectorate is cured by immediate correction of the hazard declaration and submission of updated training evidence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not triggered for ISIC 6391 (financial market news aggregation and syndication feed is a non-industrial service activity). No factory/manufacturing permit is required from the Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT); the physical-site authorities are the Provincial Fire Police (PC07) and the Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE), together with the DPI for general registration matters.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required — the enterprise is authorized to operate by its Enterprise Registration Certificate and, for a foreign investor, the Investment Registration Certificate. No separate industrial operating license or manufacturing concession applies to ISIC 6391.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) with execution delegated to the Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) under the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment. A simplified Environmental Registration (Đăng ký môi trường) must be completed for the office/data-centre ancillary premises under Article 49 of Decree 08/2022/ND-CP unless the host building already holds a cover environmental permit; if the site is located within an approved industrial/export-processing zone with a valid master environmental approval, the enterprise need only submit a written confirmation to the zone's management board.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater discharged to municipal sewerage must comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT (BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, COD ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L at Column B) or the relevant municipal wastewater discharge contract; any cooling or laboratory wastewater, if generated, must meet QCVN 40:2011/BTNMT Column A (BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, COD ≤ 75 mg/L, heavy metals) before reuse or discharge; office ventilation point-source emissions from generators or vents must not exceed QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT (dust and gases, e.g., SO2 ≤ 500 mg/Nm³, CO ≤ 1000 mg/Nm³ at Column B); ambient noise in the office area must not exceed QCVN 26:2010/BTNMT (≤ 60 dB(A) daytime in urban areas); solid waste (paper, IT consumables, toner cartridges) must be collected by a licensed collector under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP; spent batteries, UPS units, and e-waste are hazardous waste regulated under QCVN 50:2013/BTNMT and must be consigned via a licensed hazardous waste treatment contract with full online manifests maintained on the e-waste portal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety design appraisal and acceptance certificate (Thẩm duyệt thiết kế về phòng cháy, chữa cháy và Văn bản nghiệm thu) required for the occupied premises under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP, as amended by Decree No. 83/2024/ND-CP; the building must hold a valid fire safety acceptance covering the entire structure and the lessor must evidence annual inspection by the Fire Police. Structural load clearance required for any rack-mounted server or heavy equipment, evidenced by the lessor's as-built structural drawings and a signed engineering confirmation for the intended floor loading (typically not less than 2.0 kN/m² for office uses). Occupational clearance obtained through workplace hazard declaration to the district labor inspectorate under the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH14, appointment of a workplace safety coordinator, documented fire evacuation drill at least annually, first-aid kit and accessible fire hoses/extinguishers, and compliance with Circular No. 23/2022/TT-BLDTBXH on workplace inspection and safety training.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT), Ministry of Finance, Viet Nam; national e-tax portal: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; National Business Registration Portal: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-invested limited liability company: (1) obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or export-processing zone authority; (2) incorporate under the Enterprise Law and obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); (3) the tax identification number (MST) is automatically generated from the ERC through the integrated National Business Registration Information System and is also the VAT identification number; (4) if automatic issuance does not occur, submit the tax registration dossier to the local tax office under GDT within 10 working days from ERC issuance; (5) complete electronic tax account activation and register the digital signature for electronic invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope: A resident foreign-invested LLC is taxed on its worldwide corporate income at entity level. There is no pass-through eligibility; profits of the LLC are subject to enterprise income tax before distribution. The LLC is not automatically a tax-exempt zone entity unless it obtains express export-processing-enterprise (EPE), high-tech, or other statutory incentive registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or general hybrid mismatch election is available under Vietnamese tax law. Available statutory elections include: (i) VAT calculation method election between the deduction/credit method and the direct method for eligible small taxpayers; (ii) election to apply VAT credit method requires proper accounting records and valid input VAT invoices; (iii) CIT incentive registration at project inception for investment projects in eligible sectors and geographical zones; (iv) export-processing-enterprise status election requires prior written approval and creates zero-rated input VAT treatment for the EPE.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT registration threshold for LLCs or corporate entities; VAT registration and TIN issuance are mandatory upon enterprise incorporation. For household and individual business taxpayers, annual revenue exceeding VND 100,000,000 triggers mandatory VAT registration; below that amount registration is voluntary.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing applies under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. E-invoices must be generated in XML with a qualified electronic signature, transmitted to the GDT e-invoice data system, and, where a tax-authority verification code is required, obtain that code from GDT in real time before delivery to the buyer. Invoices without tax-authority codes must be transmitted no later than the day following issuance. APIs and standard data interchange formats are prescribed; all invoice data is centralized in the GDT E-Invoice System for automated tax clearance and reconciliation with customs records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate is available for goods physically exported from Viet Nam, including goods sold to export-processing enterprises, and for international transport and export services actually consumed outside Viet Nam. Required conditions are contemporaneous documentation proving the goods or services crossed the Vietnamese customs frontier, a valid export contract, customs clearance records, and foreign-currency payment evidence. Offshore services supplied to foreign organizations or individuals and consumed outside Viet Nam may qualify if they are not deemed to be consumed in Viet Nam. Failure to substantiate the export status results in mandatory VAT at the standard 10% rate plus non-deductible input VAT reversals.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic customs clearance with customs-signed status)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank confirmation of foreign-currency receipt
Swift wire transfer evidence matching the invoice value and payment terms
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to post-clearance audit by the General Department of Customs and GDT. Missing or inconsistent export documentation triggers retroactive VAT reassessment at 10%, disqualification of input VAT refunds, and statutory late-payment interest. False export declarations, fabricated customs documents, or fraudulent VAT refund claims attract administrative penalties of up to 20% of the understated tax, penalty multiples of 1-3 times the evaded amount, invoice suspension, forced cancellation of registered invoice series, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion or smuggling with imprisonment penalties up to 20 years under the Vietnamese Penal Code.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) – Foreign Exchange Administration Department (Foreign Exchange Control and Management Division)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese dong (VND) is partially convertible. Current account transactions are generally liberalized, permitting cross-border payments for trade in services, royalties, and software subscriptions without prior SBV licensing. Capital account transactions remain subject to registration, licensing, or prior approval: foreign direct investment capital contributions, foreign loans, equity transfers, and outbound investments require an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) / Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and bank account designated for capital flows. Profit remittance by a foreign-invested LLC is permitted on an annual basis after the audited financial statements are filed, the corporate income tax (CIT) finalization has been accepted, and all tax and customs obligations have been settled. A registration certificate from the SBV is generally not required for current profit remittance; the bank will verify the published annual audited financials and tax clearance. Dividends or distributions may be remitted in foreign currency from the company's foreign currency account, subject to confirmation that no overdue tax liabilities exist.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must repatriate full export proceeds into a licensed foreign currency account held with a SBV-licensed commercial bank within 180 days from the date of customs clearance, in accordance with Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN and Decree 70/2014/ND-CP. There is currently no fixed mandatory statutory conversion ratio applied to all export proceeds; however, the SBV retains the right to request credit institutions to require a proportional sale of foreign currency to the bank when systemic foreign currency demand is high. Exporters may either retain the proceeds in a foreign currency account or convert to VND freely for approved purposes. Documentation must include the customs declaration, sales contract, invoice, and transport documents.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) and digital banks not licensed by the SBV cannot independently hold VND settlement territory or provide local clearing accounts. They are not permitted to provide payment services in Vietnam without a local partnership with a licensed bank or under a separate payment intermediary licence issued by the SBV pursuant to Decree 80/2016/ND-CP and Circular 39/2014/TT-NHNN. For a financial newswire syndicated finance API, offshore EMIs such as Stripe (as payment gateway) or TransferWise/Revolut may only serve as technical rails for cross-border receipts and not for domestic VND settlement. Onboarding feasibility rating: Low for autonomous offshore operation; Medium through a licensed local payment intermediary and bank partnership. Legal constraints include mandatory processing of payment transactions through SBV-licensed banks and the prohibition of unauthorized foreign exchange conversion.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a foreign-invested LLC, Vietnamese banking rules require the ultimate legal representative (authorized signatory) to be physically present at the bank branch for the first-time account opening interview and specimen signature certification. Remote opening is technically permissible for foreign directors who execute a notarized and consular-legalized power of attorney in favor of a Vietnamese resident director, provided the authorized representative physically attends the bank branch and presents the original POA. In practice, most Tier-1 banks also require a video-KYC conference call with the foreign director as part of AML/CFT due diligence. The best-compliance approach for a syndicated finance newswire entity is to have at least one officer (CEO or CFO) appear at the selected bank branch and deliver original corporate documents. Directors who cannot appear should rely on a registered branch representative holding a Vietnamese residence status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner ultimate holding company located in a jurisdiction assessed as high-risk for money laundering (e.g., tax haven or non-cooperative jurisdiction).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate registry extracts (e.g., notarized certificate of incorporation and register of directors) from the parent company's jurisdiction; evidence of the intermediate corporate chain; audited group financial statements; tax identification numbers; evidence of legitimate business substance (employees, office addresses, active contracts); sanctions and PEP screening results; a sworn statutory declaration of ownership and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual or high-volume subscription revenue paid by multiple unrelated syndicated finance clients through e-wallets or payment processors, which may trigger structuring or layering suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master service agreements and end-user licence agreements; detailed invoices tied to API usage and webhooks; flow-of-funds diagrams linking Stripe/Wise transactions to individual subscribers; transaction-level audit trail and bank statements; independent party attestation of the company's newswire service; a comprehensive anti-money laundering policy and risk-based financial crime program.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export/import and capital-account overlapping where the LLC receives inbound capital contributions intermingled with trade revenue in the same account, causing unclear sources of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dedicated capital contribution account and operational account segregation; board resolution approving capital contribution; investment registration certificate (IRC) indicating registered capital; bank wire instructions with purpose code 'Capital Contribution' (BOP code 2.1.1); letters from the foreign investor confirming source of funding; details of the capital transfer approval with relevant tax and customs evidence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound FDI equity injections must be routed through the company's dedicated foreign direct investment (FDI) capital account at a SBV-licensed commercial bank. The founding shareholders shall transfer funds by SWIFT MT103 from the overseas investor's bank to the Vietnamese LLC's capital account. The wire instruction must include: (i) the LLC's IRC/ERC registration number; (ii) a purpose code designating the inflow as FDI equity (BOP code for direct investment); (iii) the name of the investor; (iv) a payment reference referencing the Investment Registration Certificate number and scheduled contribution tranche. The receiving bank will verify the IRC and may require a signed capital contribution declaration and the board resolution approving the capital schedule. Upon receipt, the bank will update the SBV's online registration of foreign investment and report the transaction through the External Transactions Statistics system. It is not permissible to receive inbound capital investments to the ordinary operational account without prior written approval from the SBV or the designating licensed bank.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For recurring B2B subscriptions and content licensing fees paid by overseas syndicated finance customers, the LLC's preferred outbound clearing rails include SWIFT MT103 wire transfers and, when required, commercial letters of credit evidenced by MT700/MT710. For trade settlements, the MT103 field 70 must contain an invoice number, contract reference, and a service description consistent with the underlying newswire agreement; the bank may request the signed contract and invoice before executing settlement. For domestic VND collections or when the customer settles into an intermediate digital payment account, funds must be swept into the LLC's licensed bank account and converted to VND only through an authorized bank. All FX conversions for outbound disbursements must be quoted by a licensed local bank; interbank cover payments should use MT202 for US-dollar nostro/loro settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable VND/USD forward contracts offered by SBV-licensed banks, available only for actual commercial underlying exposure (e.g., confirmed future subscription or content licensing receivables/payables), with maximum tenor of 365 days.
VND/USD currency swaps (FX swaps) permitted for corporate customers, including simultaneous spot and forward trade, subject to the same underlying economic exposure and 365-day limit.

Cross-currency swaps and certain options are available only after the bank holds a conducted derivative licence from the SBV and the end-user fulfills derivative-trading validation; however, non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible onshore for VND, as they are treated as circumvention of exchange controls. NDFs may only be traded offshore by licensed international counterparties, but a Vietnamese LLC is prohibited from directly contracting them domestically.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 March of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine of VND 10–15 million (approx. USD 400–600) under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; repeated non-filing may lead to forced enterprise registration certificate revocation after 12 months of inactive compliance status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual CIT and VAT Finalization Return (Quyết toán thuế thu nhập doanh nghiệp / VAT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Provincial Tax Department, General Department of Taxation (GDT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the fiscal year-end (fiscal year = calendar year by default)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest of 0.03% per day on unpaid tax; late filing fine of VND 4–8 million for minor delay; under-declaration penalty up to 20% of additional assessed tax; repeat offenses may trigger criminal exposure under tax fraud provisions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee Payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest of 0.03% per day; fine of 10% on underpayment; failure to pay for 12 consecutive months can trigger tax invoice suspension and enforcement measures including bank account garnishment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm đã kiểm toán)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) and Local Provincial Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from fiscal year-end, i.e., on or before 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 15–30 million for late submission of audited financial statements to DPI; separate tax authority fine of VND 10–20 million; non-compliance may be publicly published and delay future investment/operational endorsements.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all foreign-invested enterprises (FIE) in Vietnam, including foreign-invested LLCs, regardless of size, under Law on Independent Audit 2011 and Decree 17/2012/ND-CP; wholly domestic small non-listed LLCs are exempt unless exceeding applicable governmental revenue thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) as detailed in Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS permitted only for consolidated financial statements where the parent is required to file under IFRS and obtains MoF approval.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not yet mandate a separate annual UBO confirmation filing with the DPI. Under the Enterprise Law 2020, any change in members/shareholders and capital structure must be reported to DPI within 10 days of change, and the Register of Members must be updated simultaneously. The AML regime under Decree 19/2023/ND-CP requires ongoing beneficial owner identification, verification, and data updates on a 'change-triggered' basis; no standalone annual re-confirmation has been introduced.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 20% CIT. No specific statutory holiday for syndicated financial news activity (ISIC 6391). Preferential rates (e.g., 10% for 15 years) are available only for certified high-technology, software, research and infrastructure projects, and are not assumed for this entity without a specific Investment Registration Certificate.
